logline: 낡은 등잔 하나를 손에 넣은 저잣거리 소년이, 그 안에 든 것을 깨운다.
destination: 사막 아래 보물 동굴 — 한 번 들어가면 문이 닫히는 곳
protagonist: 헝클어진 검은 머리에 낡은 조끼를 걸친 열다섯 소년
setting: 옛 아라비아의 저잣거리와 사막 아래 동굴
anchor: a fifteen-year-old Arab boy with tousled black hair, a worn open vest and baggy trousers
palette: desert ochre, turquoise tile, brass gold, deep indigo shadow, warm amber

aladdin.label: 소년
aladdin.desc: a fifteen-year-old Arab boy, tousled black hair, dark eyes, a worn open vest, baggy trousers, bare feet

sorcerer.label: 낯선 사내
sorcerer.desc: a tall gaunt man in a long black robe and dark turban, hooked nose, heavy silver rings

bazaar.label: 저잣거리
bazaar.desc: a crowded Arabian market lane, striped awnings, brass wares stacked, dust in slanting light

cave.label: 보물 동굴
cave.desc: a vast underground cavern of heaped coins and vessels, stone steps, shafts of pale light

beats.visual: a barefoot boy running between striped market awnings, brass wares stacked around him
beats.motion: he runs forward down the lane, an awning snaps, dust streams behind him

beats.beat: 검은 옷의 사내가 소년을 불러 세운다.
beats.visual: a gaunt man in a black robe halting a barefoot boy in a market lane, hand raised
beats.motion: his hand lifts toward the boy, the boy stops short, dust drifts between them

beats.beat: 둘이 사막의 갈라진 바위 앞에 선다.
beats.visual: a man in black and a barefoot boy before a split boulder in open desert, sand blowing
beats.motion: sand streams past the boulder, the man's robe snaps, the crack widens

beats.visual: a barefoot boy descending worn stone steps into a cavern heaped with coins and vessels
beats.motion: he steps down the stairs into the cavern, coins slide, pale light shifts

beats.beat: 소년이 낡은 등잔 하나를 집어 든다.
beats.visual: a boy lifting a small tarnished brass lamp from among heaped treasure in a cavern
beats.motion: the lamp lifts out of the pile, coins slide down after it, dust turns in the light

beats.visual: a great split boulder grinding shut over stone steps, only a seam of light left
beats.motion: the boulder grinds closed over the steps, dust bursts outward, the light narrows

beats.visual: a boy in the dark rubbing a tarnished brass lamp with his sleeve, faint glow on his face
beats.motion: his sleeve rubs across the lamp, a glow spreads over his face, smoke curls from the spout

beats.beat: 빈 동굴 바닥에 금화만 흩어져 있다.
beats.visual: scattered gold coins on a dark cavern floor, a thin shaft of light, dust in the air
beats.motion: dust turns in the shaft of light, a coin rocks and settles, the light narrows

withheld: 등잔에서 나온 것의 정체와, 소년이 낯선 사내에게서 벗어나는 결말
